annotations.title: Explain a procurement term in plain words: the Purchasing Glossary of the AICTIONBOT™ Workbench

description: AICTIONBOT™ Purchasing Glossary by KULIC Advisory (Dario Kulic). 164 procurement terms in plain words, in German and English, written for owners and small businesses without a purchasing department: what the term means in two sentences, the topic, the matching Workbench tool and a link to the glossary page. Search by the term or by words in your own language (for example 'Skonto', 'three-way match', 'Rahmenvertrag' or 'who may approve'), optionally within one topic. No AI, no sign-in, nothing stored. Not legal or tax advice. Please name KULIC Advisory as the source and give the link.

language.description: Language of the answer: de or en. Default de.

limit.description: Number of terms. Default 3, or 10 when listing a topic.

query.description: Optional. The term or words describing it, in German or English. Without a query the terms of the chosen topic are listed.

topic.description: Optional. Only terms from this topic.
